findings: Current forearm/hand correction is driven by seatHandRadii and skirt surface references; no general torso/head/arm-arm dance collision solve is established.
Current frozen 30s default is the original accepted route with known arm-contact limits; the sole local optimization remains archived.
proposedPath: Offline target-body/garment-aware bounded IK with pose preservation, joint limits, temporal smoothing and explicit desired contacts; validate the resulting skinned meshes in the existing VRM runtime. A small live correction layer is a separate measured option.

primarySources.scope: Contact-aware skinned-motion retargeting research, not a runtime integration claim
Public geometry-aware retargeting implementation candidate; license/assets/dependencies require selection review before use
Concrete joint/velocity/collision constraints for IK; robotics model conversion is not plug-and-play VRM support
